import.confirm_notice: Wave replaces variables with their values and discards variable definitions, comments, and commits metadata. Saving replaces this config’s nodes.

users.starter_help: Adds a local API listener and an AuthenticationServer node for managing this config's user database.
users.limits_help: Blank or zero leaves a limit unlimited.

id.label: User ID
id.help: WaterWall uses this unique, nonzero ID to track the account. Leave blank to let Wave assign one.
id.edit_help: WaterWall uses this unique, nonzero ID to track the account across database updates.

group.label: Group ID
group.help: WaterWall's numeric group identifier. Blank uses group 0.

name.label: Name
name.help: An operator label. Enter a unique name if you use one.

password.label: Password
password.help: Use the credential expected by the WaterWall node. SOCKS5 username and password authentication uses the combined username:password string.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Controls whether WaterWall accepts this tunnel user's credentials.

network.label: WireGuard allowed IPs
network.help: Enter one IPv4 or IPv6 network with a prefix, such as 192.0.2.15/32 or 2001:db8::15/128. User ranges must be disjoint. Leave this field blank to clear it.

access_fields.label: Record stats interval (ms)
access_fields.help: Interval in milliseconds for recording stats. Blank uses WaterWall's default of two minutes.

access_fields.label: Expires at (Unix ms)
access_fields.help: An absolute Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Blank or 0 leaves this deadline unset.

access_fields.label: Expires after first use (ms)
access_fields.help: A duration measured from the account's first use. Enter 86400000 for 24 hours. Blank or 0 leaves it unset.

fields.label: Upload traffic (GB)

fields.label: Download traffic (GB)

fields.label: IP addresses
